basic_details.scholarship_name: Kyushu University Innovator Graduate Fellowship & MEXT Special Program
basic_details.offering_entity: Kyushu University & Japanese Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Kyushu University Ito Campus (Fukuoka, Kyushu, Japan)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Graduate School of Information Science and Electrical Engineering (ISEE): Computer Science, Advanced Information Technology, Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence, and Robotics.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~50 to 70 University-Recommended MEXT and Kyushu University Innovator Fellowships awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international merit competition; Pakistani graduate researchers in computing secure ~5 to 8 fully funded positions annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for Master's; up to 3 years for PhD, subject to satisfactory annual research evaluations
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: JPY 144,000 / month (~PKR 275,000 / month for Master's); JPY 145,000 - 180,000 / month (~PKR 277,000 - 345,000 / month for PhD)

nationality_requirements: Citizens of countries holding diplomatic relations with Japan (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Under 35 years of age on April 1 of the intake year for the MEXT track; no age limit for university internal fellowships.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) with minimum CGPA 3.30 / 4.00 (or 75%+ aggregate) from an HEC-recognized university in Pakistan for Master's; research Master's degree (18 years education) with strong thesis output for PhD.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Must achieve minimum MEXT GPA calculation of 2.30 / 3.00 over the preceding two academic years.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Rigorous undergraduate preparation in algorithms, computer architectures, linear algebra, discrete mathematics, and programming (C/C++, Python).
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating seniors in their final semester can apply conditionally with expected graduation transcripts.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior software development, open-source projects, or published research papers in IEEE/ACM venues significantly strengthen candidacy.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5, TOEFL iBT minimum 80, or institutional English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from Pakistani university.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Japanese language proficiency is not required; research and coursework are conducted 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants must contact a prospective supervising professor at Kyushu University ISEE and obtain informal preliminary consent prior to formal application.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another government scholarship simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full exemption of entrance examination fee (JPY 30,000), admission fee (JPY 282,000), and annual tuition fees (JPY 535,800 / year value).

admission_application_fee.details: Application and screening fees are 100% waived for MEXT fellowship nominees.

accommodation.details: Guaranteed on-campus single room in Kyushu University International Student Dormitory (Ito Harmony House) for the first 6-12 months; monthly rent JPY 20,000 - JPY 35,000.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free living allowance: JPY 144,000 per month for Master's (~PKR 275,000 / month; JPY 1,728,000 / year); JPY 145,000 to JPY 180,000 per month for PhD (~PKR 277,000 - 345,000 / month).

airfare.details: Prepaid economy-class flight tickets from Islamabad/Lahore/Karachi to Fukuoka Airport (FUK) at the start and return ticket upon degree completion.

visa_fee.details: Japanese College Student Visa issued free of charge for MEXT scholars by the Embassy of Japan in Islamabad or Consulate in Karachi.

health_insurance.details: Japanese National Health Insurance (NHI) premium (~JPY 2,000 / month) covers 70% of medical costs; Kyushu University Student Mutual Aid covers remaining co-pays.

food_allowance.details: Covered via the monthly living stipend of JPY 144,000 - 180,000; campus cafeterias provide halal meal options for JPY 450 - JPY 700.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Access to high-performance computing clusters, supercomputing center (Kyushu University Information Infrastructure Initiative), and research labs.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Laboratory funding available through supervisor grants (JSPS KAKENHI) for presenting papers at international conferences in Japan and abroad.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to JPY 200,000 / year upon supervisor approval

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free campus shuttle bus operating across the Ito Campus grounds; subsidized student passes for Showa Bus to local railway stations.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single premier Japanese national imperial university: Kyushu University (Kyudai).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: One of Japan's prestigious 7 Designated National Imperial Universities; ranked top 150 globally in QS World University Rankings and top 100 for Engineering & Technology.
available_majors: Advanced Information Technology and Software Systems
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 2 years for Master's; 3 years for PhD
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree in CS/EE, minimum MEXT GPA 2.3/3.0, informal supervisor consent, statement of research proposal, two recommendation letters, and certified English proficiency.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: ISEE research labs in AI, Cybersecurity, and Robotics have high competition; securing supervisor endorsement between September and November is the primary determinant of admission and funding.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Pakistani applicants should browse the Kyushu University ISEE faculty directory, find matching professors in AI/computing, and email a tailored research proposal and CV between September and November for the October intake.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Kyushu University ISEE Graduate Admissions System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Contact prospective supervisor directly via email, obtain formal letter of provisional acceptance, and submit the university-recommended MEXT / Innovator fellowship application to the ISEE student affairs office.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Identify research laboratories in Kyushu University Graduate School of ISEE matching your technical interests.
Step 2: Email prospective supervisor with academic transcripts, CV, and a 2-3 page research proposal to obtain informal provisional acceptance (September - November).
Step 3: Receive formal application documents from the ISEE student affairs section upon supervisor nomination.
Step 4: Submit complete MEXT application dossier, attested transcripts, degrees, recommendation letters, and medical certificate by early January.
Step 5: ISEE faculty committee conducts technical screening and nominates top candidates to MEXT / university fellowship board in February.
Step 6: Official award notification issued in June.
Step 7: Arrive in Fukuoka in late September to commence studies in October.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Supervisor Track: Application is submitted through the supervising professor and graduate school directly.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted on institutional letterhead signed by the Dean or Department Head of the Pakistani university.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Field of study and research plan outlining previous research experience and detailed thesis proposal for Kyushu University.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured 3 to 5-page research proposal detailing background, problem formulation, methodology, and expected timeline.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed academic CV highlighting technical projects, publications, programming proficiencies, and awards.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 30 to 45-minute technical video interview via Zoom conducted by prospective supervisor and lab faculty members.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (min 6.5), TOEFL iBT (min 80), or institutional English MOI certificate accepted; GRE not required.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: JPY 0 (100% waived for MEXT fellowship applicants)
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts attested by HEC and MOFA Pakistan; Matric/Inter by IBCC.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation required for all official documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Digital dossier submission followed by physical document dispatch to Kyushu University ISEE.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificates
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts for 4-year Bachelor's with minimum CGPA 3.3/4.0 and MEXT GPA 2.3/3.0.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested copies from HEC and MOFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Field of Study and Research Plan (Kenkyu Keikakusho)
required_documents_checklist.specification: Official MEXT formatted research proposal detailing background, methodology, and thesis timeline.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be closely aligned with prospective Kyushu University supervisor's lab projects.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Letter of Provisional Acceptance from Kyushu University Professor
required_documents_checklist.specification: Informal written consent from an ISEE professor agreeing to serve as academic supervisor.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Obtained directly through email academic correspondence.

required_documents_checklist.specification: One letter from Dean or Head of Department; one from thesis advisor or senior professor.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Printed on official Pakistani university letterhead.

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic (min 6.5), TOEFL iBT (min 80), or institutional English MOI letter.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: MOI letter signed by university registrar.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official medical fitness certificate signed by an authorized physician.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Completed at an authorized diagnostic center.

required_documents_checklist.specification: High-resolution color scan of passport data page valid for at least 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must have validity through late 2028.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main intake for university-recommended MEXT track is October. Supervisor contact must begin 10 to 12 months in advance.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Undergraduate GPA and performance in core computing and engineering courses)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Quality of research proposal, supervisor match, and previous publications/capstone)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of academic intent and justification for Kyushu University)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 0% (Interview performance factored directly into supervisor endorsement)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Kyushu University ISEE Faculty Admissions Board and MEXT Fellowship Committee.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-phase evaluation: supervisor nomination followed by faculty committee academic ranking.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~600 to 900 international applicants across ISEE laboratories
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~50 to 70 fully funded positions awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~8% to 12% among candidates with supervisor consent
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: CGPA 3.50+ / 4.00 from top Pakistani engineering institutions (NUST, FAST, GIKI, UET, NED)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with exceptional computing foundations, strong software engineering practices, published research, or substantial GitHub project portfolios.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani computer science, software engineering, and electronic engineering faculties.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, China, Indonesia, Vietnam, Bangladesh, India, Egypt, Thailand.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of unauthorized agents claiming to sell guaranteed MEXT scholarships.
Applications are processed exclusively through Kyushu University faculty channels.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Kyushu University and MEXT do NOT charge application fees for scholarship nominees.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Kyushu University does not work with third-party recruitment agencies.
hidden_costs_breakdown: HEC and MOFA document attestations in Pakistan: ~PKR 25,000.
Medical examination and chest X-ray on MEXT form: ~PKR 15,000.
Initial pocket money before first stipend disbursement: ~JPY 50,000 (~PKR 95,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You must know Japanese to study in Japan. Reality: Kyushu University ISEE programs are conducted 100% in English.
Myth: MEXT scholars have to pay taxes on their stipend. Reality: The MEXT monthly stipend is 100% tax-free under Japanese law.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial websites claim GRE is mandatory; GRE is NOT mandatory for Kyushu University ISEE.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain good academic standing and MEXT GPA >= 2.3/3.0 throughout the degree program.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research attendance in the designated laboratory on Ito Campus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress report submitted to the Graduate School Dean and MEXT.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Permitted to work part-time up to 28 hours per week with immigration permission (Shikakugai Katsudo Kyoka), but supervisor consent required.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No mandatory return requirement; graduates are free to work in Japan or globally.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bond or repayment obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding cancelled if the student abandons studies, is expelled, or engages in misconduct.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires consent of both current and prospective supervisors and faculty board approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Master's graduates can apply for MEXT extension to continue into the PhD program based on competitive research merit.
